description: Parking relais Paul Féval - Navettes de bus 2016 is a dataset listed in Data.StMalo-Agglomération open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Saint-Malo. Le parking-relais Paul Féval se situe à l’entrée de la ville de Saint-Malo, près de l’hippodrome de Marville. Coverage: Saint-Malo Agglomération. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are bus, transport. The portal shows 88 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2016-04-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-stmalo-agglomeration-fr-portal.
